name: Call of Air - Guse's Fleet
label: Quest
description: Call of Air - Guse's Fleet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must prepare the new fleet of War Riders, traveler! My riders are set to make a strike on the central battlefield; but first, I must wet their appetites - preparing them for the assault.
I need enough Stormpike Soldier Flesh to feed a fleet! Hundreds of pounds! Surely you can handle that, yes? Get going!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The fleet feeds on their flesh. It consumes the enemy.
